## Corporate proxy

When `HTTPS_PROXY` or `HTTP_PROXY` is set (either case), the CLI process sends its `fet
ch` requests through the proxy and honors `NO_PROXY`: MCPJam's API, model providers and MCP servers over HTTP. `HTTPS_PROXY` cover
s `https` destinations and `HTTP_PROXY` covers `http` ones; with only `HTTP_PROXY` set, `https` requests use it too. `localhost`,
`127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` always connect directly, so local MCP servers and the local Inspector keep working. A value without a sche
me, such as `proxy.corp.com:8080`, means `http://`; a value that is not an http(s) URL is ignored with a warning. Two connections
do not use the proxy yet: the relay connection of `mcpjam cloud tunnel` and the `mcpjam oauth` debugging proxy.\n\nThe update chec
k runs in a separate short-lived process that uses Node.js's own proxy support. On Node.js older than 22.21, or 24.x older than 24
.5, the check is skipped while a proxy is set rather than sent directly.\n\nFor a TLS-inspecting proxy or a private CA, trust its
root certificate the Node.js way: `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/path/to/ca.pem`, or, on Node.js 22.15 or later, `NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system
-ca` to use the system store; older releases refuse to start with that option. Set either in the environment the CLI starts in.",

When
`HTTPS_PROXY` or `HTTP_PROXY` is set (either case), the CLI process sends its `fetch` requests through the proxy and honors `NO_PR
OXY`: MCPJam's API, model providers and MCP servers over HTTP. `HTTPS_PROXY` covers `https` destinations and `HTTP_PROXY` covers `
